diagnosis: The independent eight-step prefix did not measure the task-local failure mode.
Mode-equality utility made raw categorical mismatch nearly sufficient.
A constant unit-level predictor could not resolve first-failure timing.
Adding all TSI features did not repair the mismatch and sometimes increased held-out Brier loss.
nonrepairs: The predictive SESOI was not lowered.
The failed development artifacts and source snapshot were retained.
